newsitem.title: USA: Starbucks said up on optimistic outlook.
newsitem.headline: Starbucks said up on optimistic outlook.

text.p: Starbucks Corp stock jumped Thursday after executives expressed optimism about the current holiday quarter and reported earnings in line with expectations, analysts said.
Starbucks jumped 2-5/8 to 34-1/2 after reporting fiscal fourth quarter earnings of $0.16 a share, in line with analyst expectations and more than double the $0.07 reported a year earlier.
Starbucks had fallen 1-3/4 Wednesday on a variety of factors that created a negative market psychology, said Diane Daggatt of Dain Bosworth.
She said executives revealed little new in a conference call with analysts after the earnings announcement, but she said Chairman Howard Schultz was "extremely upbeat."
"They were extremely optimistic about Christmas," she said. Gift items for sale during the holiday season will be more "vibrant" and traditional than last year, she said.
Starbucks also reiterated plans to roll out its bottled Frappuccino beverage next summer in a joint venture with PepsiCo Inc.
